projects.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
projects.logline: Pushpa Raj faces a fierce war with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat and syndicate bosses as his red-sandalwood empire expands.
projects.description: Pushpa Raj consolidates his syndicate empire across the Seshachalam forests into international waters, colliding with SP Bhanwar Singh Shekhawat in an explosive showdown of ego, survival, and absolute dominance.

projects.title: Kalki 2898 AD
projects.producer: C. Aswani Dutt, Swapna Dutt, Priyanka Dutt
projects.logline: In the dystopian city of Kasi 2898 AD, bounty hunter Bhairava and the immortal Ashwatthama clash over pregnant refugee Sumathi carrying the savior of mankind.
projects.description: Set in a post-apocalyptic future where the Complex controls all resources, Kalki 2898 AD follows Bhairava, the immortal warrior Ashwatthama, and Supreme Yaskin in an epic technological-mythological clash for the unborn avatar.

projects.title: Devara: Part 1
projects.logline: A fearless coastal chieftain Devara fights to stop his clan's smuggling empire, leaving his fearful son Varadha to protect his legacy from ruthless rivals.
projects.description: Spanning the treacherous coastal tides of the Red Sea clan, Devara: Part 1 chronicles the fierce confrontation between Devara and Bhaira over arms smuggling, family vengeance, and enduring bloodlines.

projects.title: Game Changer
projects.logline: An unyielding IAS officer wages war against corrupt political kingpins to revolutionize state electoral democracy.
projects.description: Ram Nandan IAS spearheads a fierce battle against deeply entrenched political corruption, deploying radical constitutional mechanisms and voter awareness to defeat an oligarchic syndicate.

projects.title: They Call Him OG
projects.logline: Ojas Gambheera, a feared underworld boss who vanished a decade ago, resurfaces in Mumbai to settle unfinished blood debts.
projects.description: Ten years after vanishing into exile, gangster Ojas Gambheera (OG) returns to the Mumbai underworld to dismantle criminal baron Omi Bhau's syndicate in a stylish neo-noir bloodbath.

projects.title: HIT: The Third Case
projects.logline: Fierce cop Arjun Sarkaar is drafted into the Homicide Intervention Team's darkest cross-border serial murder investigation.

scenes.heading: EXT. CHARMINAR LANE - DAWN
scenes.notes: Opening visual language for the old city.
scenes.synopsis: Rishi fixes a bike before sunrise as the lane around him wakes up.

scenes.heading: INT. RADIO DECCAN STUDIO - MORNING
scenes.notes: Fast-paced banter.
scenes.synopsis: Zara's off-air frustration slips into her live segment and Kabir notices.

scenes.heading: EXT. TANK BUND - SUNSET
scenes.notes: Emotional turning point before the plan turns public.
scenes.synopsis: Rishi convinces Zara to risk a pirate citywide broadcast.

scenes.heading: INT. IRANI CAFE - NIGHT
scenes.notes: Keep the rhythm playful until the ledger lands.
scenes.synopsis: Kabir reads the ledger and realizes the lane is historically protected.

scenes.heading: EXT. LAAD BAZAAR ROOFTOP - MAGIC HOUR
scenes.vfxNotes: Remove modern hoardings and extend old-city skyline glow.
scenes.notes: Small romantic beat without undercutting the pace.
scenes.synopsis: Zara admits why she stopped showing her face on air.

scenes.heading: INT/EXT. MMTS LOCAL - DAY

costumes.name: Rishi backup shirt for stunt duplicate

scenes.notes: Action-comedy pace.
scenes.synopsis: A permit file slips onto a departing train and the chase goes public online.

scenes.heading: EXT. MUSI GHAT - NIGHT
scenes.vfxNotes: Clean modern skyline spill and add distant prayer lights.
scenes.notes: One of the quietest scenes in the film.
scenes.synopsis: Ammajaan reveals the file was hidden to protect the street's families, not the land.

scenes.heading: INT. RECORDING VAN - NIGHT

specialRequirements.name: LED scrolling city lights outside van

scenes.notes: Hold close for the confession.
scenes.synopsis: Zara uses her voice, and finally her name, to ask the city to show up.

scenes.heading: EXT. GODAVARI JUNCTION PLATFORM - DAWN
scenes.vfxNotes: Platform extension and dawn fog enhancement.
scenes.notes: Pilot opener.
scenes.synopsis: Subbu begins another morning at the station, unaware that Revathi is on the arriving train.

scenes.heading: INT. STATION TEA STALL - DAY
scenes.notes: Family friction, quick pace.
scenes.synopsis: Revathi returns to sell the canteen and learns Subbu has promised the station another festival contract.

scenes.heading: EXT. RIVER JETTY - DUSK
scenes.notes: Atmospheric discovery scene.
scenes.synopsis: Revathi retrieves a water-damaged ledger that proves the missing singer boarded from this station.

scenes.heading: EXT. PLATFORM 2 - NIGHT RAIN
scenes.vfxNotes: Train crowd extension and rain cleanup.
scenes.notes: Episode ending beat.
scenes.synopsis: Ashwin corners Subbu just as a passenger carrying the missing singer's trunk steps onto the platform.

scenes.heading: EXT. BUS STAND CORNER - DAY
scenes.notes: Reveals Ashwin's separate agenda.
scenes.synopsis: Ashwin quietly takes a payoff and realizes the missing case is much bigger than he thought.

scenes.notes: Finished.
